Give yourself and nearby willing allies 1 Boon to defenses. Sustain the shelter with a Maneuver each turn.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self and willing allies within 2 squares.
Limits
Maintain one shelter at a time.
Type
Magic / Defense

Until the end of your next turn, you and willing allies within 2 squares gain 1 Boon to defenses while in that area. On later turns, you may spend a Maneuver to sustain the shelter until the end of your next turn.
